study_identification_part.si_4_title: Normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in basal ganglia on healthy ageing

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABRIM (Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory): A healthy ageing cohort of 260 participants used to derive normative trajectories. PPP (Personalized Parkinson Project): An independent cohort of 44 healthy controls and 316 Parkinson's disease patients used for validation.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Data utilised to derive the normative trajectories is part of the Advanced Brain Imaging on Ageing and Memory (ABRIM) data collection... To study the applicability of the R2* and χ normative models derived from the ABRIM datasets, an independent cohort... part of the 'Personalized Parkinson Project' (PPP) data collection... was used.

answer.PPP: external validation and clinical utility assessment

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABRIM was the primary dataset used to compute normative trajectories for R1, R2*, and susceptibility using Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) with 10-fold cross-validation. PPP served as an independent validation set to test the model's applicability and clinical sensitivity (comparing PD patients vs. controls).
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: In this study, we established the normative trajectories of R1, R2*, and magnetic susceptibility in the basal ganglia... We used a healthy ageing cohort [ABRIM] comprising 260 subjects... Finally, the utility of normative modelling of qMRI in the basal ganglia is validated using an independent cohort [PPP] comprising both healthy participants and individuals with Parkinson's disease

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The normative models were developed using the ABRIM cohort (N=260). For R2* and susceptibility, an additional 44 healthy controls from the PPP cohort were used for external validation, bringing the overall healthy sample for these metrics to 304. R1 was only modeled and validated internally within the ABRIM cohort.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: resulting in data of 260 participants to be included in the statistical analysis... In this analysis, data from 44 healthy volunteers and 316 patients [from PPP] were used.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Model-1 (R1) used only ABRIM (N=260, Mean=50.8, SD=16.8, Range=18-79). Model-2 (R2*, Susceptibility) included external validation on PPP controls (N=44, Mean=58.2, SD=9.2). Weighted mean and pooled SD were calculated for the combined R2*/Susceptibility overall phase (N=304).
